question: Replace missing values in all numeric columns of the dataset with their respective column medians. After imputation, report the number and percentage of missing values filled.

expected_output.guidelines: Per-column missing counts must be exact; missing percentages within +/-0.05; median values within 1% relative absolute error; row and column order may differ.
All numeric values must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error; row order, column order, and header labels may differ.
